description: List and filter the robot lawn mowers in the BestRobotMower.co dataset by brand, navigation type, price, lawn-area coverage, slope handling and score. Returns models ranked by the 0-5 BestRobotMower Score (highest first).

limit.description: Max models to return (default 10, max 39, the whole catalog).

max_price_usd.description: Only models at or below this USD price.

min_lawn_area_m2.description: Only models that cover at least this lawn area in square metres.

min_score.description: Only models with a BestRobotMower Score at or above this value (0-5).

min_slope_pct.description: Only models rated for at least this slope, in percent grade.

navigation.description: Filter by navigation type, case-insensitive substring (e.g. 'RTK', 'satellite', 'vision', 'wire').

name: list_robot_mowers
title: List robot mowers
